critical_code_review_comments: Minor UX polish (not a bug): after closeBillSession discards the CURRENTLY ACTIVE bill, sidRef.current still points to the deleted sid (clearAll runs but sid is not rotated to a fresh _newSid). On next reload the mount effect finds no draft under that sid and silently starts a new session — this is the observed behaviour and it is safe, but a next-item action would be persisted under a stale sid and could show up as a bill chip with an orphan-looking label until the user adds items. Consider: `if (s.sid === sidRef.current) { sidRef.current = _newSid(); sessionStorage.setItem('pos_sid', sidRef.current); }` inside doClose.

The Add Guest modal shows the amber duplicate panel on 409 but keeps the phone field editable — good. Small UX suggestion: auto-focus the phone field when 'Change number' is clicked so staff can immediately retype.
CustomerHistoryModal renders up to N bills without pagination or virtualisation. For heavy guests (>200 visits) this could get slow — consider capping to last 50 with a 'Load more'.

React hydration warnings observed in console: `<span> option` cannot be a child of an <option> element — caused by BranchSwitcher wrapping option label content in a <span>. Pre-existing (not introduced by this feature) but should be cleaned to keep the console signal-to-noise usable during regression.
action_items: Optional: rotate sidRef.current to a fresh sid inside closeBillSession when the currently active bill is closed (see review comment #1).
